clue.text: Improve efficiency of run in old railway

indicators.note: in tells us the run is placed inside the old railway

parts.note: a steam line is a railway of the steam era
R is the cricket scoring abbreviation for a run

explanation.surface: A manager speeds up operations on a heritage steam railway.
explanation.definitionFit: To streamline a process is to simplify it so it works faster and more smoothly.

clue.text: One of the branches controlled by banks

definitions.text: One of the branches controlled by banks

parts.words: One of the branches controlled by banks
parts.note: read as a bank branch, but the banks are a river's, holding in a stream that branches off it

explanation.surface: An office of a financial company run by the big banks.
explanation.definitionFit: A tributary is a stream feeding a river, flowing between its own banks.

clue.text: Like courses finished in college, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals a word that sounds like another when spoken

parts.note: Eton is the famous English public school, Eton College

explanation.surface: Students finish their courses at college.
explanation.walkthrough: 'courses' suggests study, but they are courses of a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Courses of a meal that are finished have been consumed.

clue.text: Prepare to become a breadwinner

definitions.meaning: a printing term for getting ready
ready is slang for cash, so this means to earn money

explanation.surface: Someone gets ready to start earning for the family.
explanation.definitionFit: Printers use the phrase for preparing a press, and ready money is cash, so it also means earning.

clue.text: Establish the location of many a farm animal

definitions.meaning: to set up or put in place

definitions.text: the location of many a farm animal
definitions.meaning: a horse or cow is kept in a stall, read as two words

explanation.surface: Someone works out where farm animals are kept.
explanation.definitionFit: To install is to set up in position, and split in two it says where a cow is.

clue.text: A few good shots, and hunting dog's heading off

indicators.note: heading off removes the first letter of the dog

parts.note: a beagle is a hound used for hunting hares

explanation.surface: A hunter fires a few good shots while their dog runs off.
explanation.definitionFit: In golf, two under par on a hole means the hole was played in very few strokes.

clue.text: The best tool for road repairs

definitions.meaning: the choicest or finest of a selection, as in the top choice
a pickaxe used to break up road surfaces

explanation.surface: Someone names the finest implement for mending roads.
explanation.definitionFit: A pickaxe breaks tarmac, and the choicest item is likewise called the pick of the bunch.

clue.text: Someone sitting on a horse

parts.note: a percher is one who perches or sits
on is taken as written

explanation.surface: A rider sits on a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: The Percheron is a heavy French draught breed.

clue.text: Degree students

definitions.meaning: a grade of honours degree, as in a first
a group of pupils taught together

explanation.surface: A degree course full of students.
explanation.definitionFit: British honours degrees are graded as firsts and seconds, and a body of students is a form.

clue.text: Girl carrying receipts slips

indicators.note: the girl carries the receipts, holding them inside her

parts.note: a miss is a girl or young woman
the take is the money received, as in a shop's takings

explanation.surface: A shop girl drops the day's receipts as she carries them.
explanation.definitionFit: Slips are small errors, as in slips of the tongue.

clue.text: Composer of the Wagnerian type

parts.note: Wagner's nationality: a composer of his type is one from the same country

explanation.surface: A music critic classifies a composer as being in the mould of Wagner.
explanation.walkthrough: Wagner was born in Leipzig, so a composer of his type is read as one of his nationality rather than his style.
explanation.definitionFit: Wagner came from Leipzig, so his countrymen share his nationality.

clue.text: Shoot? Pistol gives me a start

definitions.meaning: a stem sent out along the ground by a plant such as a strawberry
a sprinter on the track sets off at the starting pistol

explanation.surface: Someone told to shoot replies that a pistol shot sets them off.
explanation.definitionFit: A strawberry's creeping stem is so named, and a sprinter starts a race at the gun.

clue.text: Stone set my hat spinning

indicators.note: spinning sends the letters of set my hat whirling into a new order

explanation.surface: A gem is set on a hat that is sent spinning.
explanation.definitionFit: This purple quartz is a semi-precious gemstone.

clue.text: Minister's first to enter better political group

indicators.note: to enter means the minister's initial goes inside the word for better

parts.note: to cap something is to better or outdo it

indicators.note: first asks for the opening letter of Minister's

explanation.surface: The first minister joins a superior faction within the party.
explanation.definitionFit: A camp is a faction sharing a political position, as in the opposing camp.

clue.text: Still the same in the office?

parts.note: a still is a single photograph, as from a film
a copy is something exactly the same as the original

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether nothing has changed at work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Still the same' reads as 'unchanged', but it is a picture plus a duplicate; the definition is a description, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Duplicating documents on a machine is a typical office task, and that duplicate is what the clue describes.

clue.text: Total fury is very fashionable

definitions.meaning: all of the anger there is

explanation.surface: Someone's complete rage is said to be the latest trend.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase literally means every bit of anger, and idiomatically means currently in vogue.

clue.text: Graph representing logarithms without line

indicators.note: representing suggests the letters are rearranged to stand for something else
without means the letter for line is dropped

explanation.surface: A chart that shows logarithms but has no line on it.
explanation.definitionFit: A histogram is a bar chart of frequencies.

clue.text: Variety of pager, new, interrupting rival communication network

indicators.note: a variety of the word pager is a different arrangement of its letters
interrupting means the new letter breaks into the word for rival

parts.note: to vie is to compete or rival

explanation.surface: A new model of pager disrupts a competitor's network.
explanation.definitionFit: Hearing something through the grapevine means by informal word of mouth.

clue.text: My young son's misbehaving, not good — or similarly defined

indicators.note: misbehaving shows the letters running wild out of their order
not means the letter for good is left out of the fodder

parts.note: the possessive s counts here as a letter of the fodder

explanation.surface: A parent complains that their small son is behaving badly, or at least something like that.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove G from MYYOUNGSONS and 'misbehaving' rearranges the remaining ten letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Words that are similarly defined share a meaning, like synonyms.

clue.text: Performing male may be seen in one

indicators.note: may be seen in places the male inside the number word

parts.note: one is taken as written
a stag is a male deer

explanation.surface: A male performer is visible in a single show.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor who is on the boards in front of an audience is performing.

clue.text: Head of agency caught like a fish out of water?

indicators.note: caught means the agency's initial is trapped inside the mesh

parts.note: a fish is caught in a net, so this is the mesh that holds it

indicators.note: Head of asks for the first letter of agency

explanation.surface: An agency boss feels like a fish out of water.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface's idiom 'a fish out of water' is broken up: the fish is netted, and 'out of water' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A spirit served without added water or mixer is served neat.

clue.text: Wakes, stifling surprised cry, and moves to a new place

indicators.note: stifling means the cry is smothered inside the word for wakes

parts.note: rouses means wakes someone up
eh is an exclamation of surprise

explanation.surface: Someone is woken, swallows a startled cry, and moves house.
explanation.definitionFit: To rehouse people is to provide them with new accommodation elsewhere.

clue.text: Corresponding use of keys

parts.note: corresponding as writing letters, done by typing on a keyboard

explanation.surface: Keys that match each other used for locks.
explanation.definitionFit: Electronic messages are typed on a keyboard and are a modern form of correspondence.

clue.text: Stick man?

definitions.meaning: to man a post is to provide it with workers

explanation.surface: A child's stick-figure drawing.
explanation.definitionFit: A walking pole and the act of supplying workers share this word.

clue.text: Selling point with words heard in court

parts.note: a line judge on a tennis court calls a ball out
an umpire calls let when a serve clips the net

explanation.surface: Testimony overheard in a courtroom turns out to be a sales pitch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'court' suggests a law court, but it is a tennis court, where umpires call OUT and LET.
explanation.definitionFit: An outlet is a shop or market through which goods are sold.

clue.text: Teacher's expression of disgust over our skipping university

indicators.note: in a down clue over places the exclamation above the rest

parts.note: tut is a sound of disapproval

indicators.note: skipping means the university letter is left out of our

explanation.surface: A teacher tuts in disgust when we skip university.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of Teacher's stands for 'is', a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A tutor is a private teacher or university supervisor.

clue.text: Spicy snack? Article found on island (with second in other islands)

indicators.note: in an across clue, found on places the article after the island

parts.note: Samos is a Greek island in the Aegean
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A newspaper article about a spicy snack is found while on holiday on an island.
explanation.walkthrough: The bracket gives a second route: S (second) inside SAMOA, the Pacific islands, also makes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A samosa is a fried triangular pastry with a spiced filling, from South Asian cooking.

clue.text: Spreads news of accident in landing area

parts.note: to air something is to make it public, so airs means spreads news
a trip is a stumble, a minor accident

explanation.surface: Someone broadcasts news of a crash at an aerodrome.
explanation.definitionFit: An airstrip is a basic runway where small aircraft touch down.

clue.text: Human body left in island

indicators.note: in puts the letter for left inside the island

parts.note: a cay is a small low island or reef

explanation.surface: A human body is left on an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Clay is the mortal flesh in biblical imagery, man being formed from the dust of the earth.

clue.text: Swift to snap up a print in place offering bargains

indicators.note: to snap up means the swift word grabs the other letters and holds them inside

parts.note: fleet means swift, as in fleet of foot
a mark is a print or impression

explanation.surface: Someone rushes to buy a print at a bargain stall.
explanation.definitionFit: A street market selling second-hand goods cheaply is known by this name.
